I went back through every statement, communiqué and meeting worth considering to see how this relationship evolved:

07/2016: Somalia 🇸🇴 signs (with 27 other African countries) a motion to the African Union calling for the suspension of the so-called “SADR”.

11/2016: Somalia 🇸🇴 walks out (with 7 other countries) of the Africa-Arab summit over the presence of the so-called “SADR”.

03/2019: Somalia 🇸🇴 declares: “We stand with Morocco 🇲🇦 on the question of its territorial integrity.”

11/2020: Somalia 🇸🇴 explicitly backs the measures taken by Morocco 🇲🇦 to defend its El Guergarat border crossing.

04/2022: Somalia’s Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs attends the inauguration of a research center in Dakhla.

09/2022: Somalia 🇸🇴 announces it will open a consulate in Dakhla and states it “supports the territorial integrity of Morocco 🇲🇦.”

10/2023: Somalia’s embassy in Rabat 🇸🇴 is inaugurated.

31/10/2025: Somalia 🇸🇴 votes in favor of Resolution 2797 at the UN Security Council 🇺🇳.

28/11/2025: Somalia 🇸🇴 “reaffirms its support for Morocco’s 🇲🇦 sovereignty” and “congratulates” the adoption of Resolution 2797.

Then came the U-turn... ⬇️

06/12/2025: Somalia 🇸🇴 merely “takes note” of Resolution 2797, calls on “the parties to negotiate” and pledges to “respect the sovereignty of every country” (see 3rd image).

30/10/2026: Somalia 🇸🇴 abstains on the US draft at the UN Security Council 🇺🇳, warning that some provisions “could prejudge the outcome of the negotiations”, then votes for Russia’s alternative text.

By the way, Somalia 🇸🇴 never opened the Dakhla consulate it has promised to open back in 2022.

Solaris. Ocean of Generative Code

“Scarlet Transforma” is a magical, extremely timid, yet curious substance. To camouflage itself, it invents its own transformations, imitating familiar objects. And it is terribly embarrassed by its generative errors…🙄🤣

But today, the trend for funny AI glitches accidentally revealed the origin of a new bird. 💁‍♀️And all she wanted was to prove that she was a real fashion model! 🤍🫧☺️💅🏻💅🏻💅🏻

How is she supposed to camouflage herself when even mistakes become fashionable? 🤣

And who is imitating whom now — is generative code imitating reality, or is reality imitating generative code?😊
